name: M9-3B-23, 1PS
headline: Seascape 1 BDR @ Mangroovy | Pool & Sea View
summary: This attractive 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with a free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This stunning pool & sea view 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a  free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The 1 bedroom apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 1 full bathroom with 1 ensuite and a living room with a L shaped sofa, not to mention a beautiful large balcony and a rooftop terrace overlooking the pool. The unit is directly facing the pool and is enjoys a partial sea view as well .

It also features a 65 inch curved smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples. 

The styling is made vibrant to ensure guests have a wonderful and relaxing experience. 


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Abu Tig Marina. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Stunning 2 minutes walk to a beautiful big beach, free for those staying at the apartment. The apartment is well equipped and the host provided shampoo, conditioner, towels etc during the stay. If you need towels for the swimming pool or the beach, they are not provided though. The apartment, the area and the whole El Gouna is spotlessly clean and well maintained and there is no hassling of tourists like in other areas of Egypt. There are plenty of restaurants.The apartment has a balcony that is shaded throughout the day but if you want to stay in the sun, there is a very big roof terrace exclusive to this apartment with sofas and other seating options. The roof terrace has a shaded area as well. Another great thing is that you can see the sunset from the terrace. The nearest supermarket is around 7 minutes walk, it has basic things but if you are planning on cooking, you may need to go to a slightly bigger one near the marina or go to a much bigger one Gourmet near the festival plaza.
The place was awesome, super clean and everything was perfect. It is close to a lot of cafes and restaurants and I totally recommend it.

Lack of communication regarding QR code access to resort and complex, security lock for key is hard to work, no one answered the number you are requested to use - very poor also no toilet roll - it’s the simple things that make the stay better, also some light bulbs not working.

A decent apartment in a nice compound but a disappointing experience with Xuru Stays, the management company - not with the housekeeping team who were kind! Having stayed in a lot of Airbnbs, simple gestures such as a welcome bottle of water, basic cooking necessities and at the very least washing up materials are expected. In addition, the lack of flexibility around check-in/check-out times particularly when there were no subsequent guests (2 hours extra is charged at 50% of the daily rate and an entire night is charged for any time beyond that) was extremely disappointing. While the company did provide the missing cleaning products and a complementary fruit basket, it was clear this was out of concern for a bad review rather than a genuine understanding of the issue. The beauty of Airbnb is a kind of hospitality and flexibility that often doesn’t exist in hotels but this simply isn’t the case with Xuru Stays. And that’s before one even mentions the fact this isn’t a cheap Airbnb.

Le logement était impeccable, avec un petit plus pour les serviettes fournies, ce qui m’a bien aidé puisque je n’en avais pas apporté. L’appartement offrait une belle vue sur la piscine et un aperçu de la plage. 
Les bémols ? L’accès au logement est difficile avec des travaux littéralement partout ! De plus, la terrasse sur le toit est un espace commun accessible aux autres résidents, et j’ai parfois subi des coupures d’électricité.

Concernant la ville, El Gouna est ultra sécurisée, avec une présence policière omniprésente. Cela garantit un cadre paisible, sans nuisances sonores ni klaxons, et des tarifs de taxi fixes (1 €). En revanche, l’accès est très restreint : mes amis n’ont pas pu me rejoindre, car un QR code est obligatoire, disponible uniquement pour les résidents ou ceux ayant réservé une activité sur place.

Enfin, merci à l’hôte, qui a su gérer efficacement un problème de voisins bruyants.

Mon expérience à El Gouna est mitigée, mais l’hébergement niquel.

1. Terrace is completely useless and should not contribute a cent to apartment's price. You basically get a cramped apartment (30 m2 max I beleive) on the 3rd floor (or 2nd if not count ground floor). The terrace is on the 4th floor and is accessible only through a public stairway. There are 3 or 4 terraces on the roof, separated by waist-high walls. The furniture is not usable as it leaves dustry traces on clothes and you wouldn't want to seat on it anyway. Photos at booking.com are completely misleading in that respect. In reality everything is extremely dirty and is not cleanable because that furniture is intended for indoor use and they put it outdoor at a windy spot. The terrace door was not even locked, I later realised why - because nobody ever uses those terraces and nobody cares if they are locked or not. I didn't notice a single person on a single terrace throughout whole Mangroovy compound over our 16 days stay there. We asked the owners to bring the outdoor furniture to the terrace to make it at least partially usable, but that request was ignored. And so was ignored the request to bring a folding bed for our kid.

2. The apartment is not that bright and nice as in the photos. Actually it is dark, worn out and extremely small. There is no hallway at all, you literally get to the living room straight from the stairway.

Our disapointment aggravated after our friends had arrived and checked in 120 m2 two bedroom ground floor apartment with a lawn, spacious living room, direct access to the pool and that apartment was cheaper than ours. My recomendation is to book ground floor apartments at Mangroovy, whereas 2nd and especially 3rd floor apartments (provided that terraces are completely pointless) should be massively discounted relative to ground floor. In our case it was the other way around though.

Overall my feeling is that the this apatment is advertised in a deceiving manner at booking.com so beware

Небольшая квартира рядом с мариной (5 минут пешком). Закрытая ухоженная зеленая территория, есть большой бассейн, пляж. До моря 3 минуты. 

Обратите внимание, что квартира находится на 3 этаже без лифта. Если у вас много багажа, дети или пожилые люди, это будет не очень комфортно. 

Из плюсов: есть балкон с видом на море. Квартира небольшая, но есть все необходимое: кухня, чайник, стиральная машина, фен, утюг, даже кофе-машина.
